subject: Data quality for driver safety models
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded Motive away from their in-house tools as they moved from frame-based to video annotation. Like many driver safety teams, they faced challenges around handling billions of miles of in-cab and dashcam footage, e.g. surfacing relevant driver behaviours and maintaining temporal consistency for high quality video datasets. 

I imagine [COMPANY] is also working towards more accurate driver safety models, have you run into similar challenges? Sharing a few bullets on why Motive moved to Encord: 
Model-assisted labelling to cut down repetitive frame-by-frame work Consolidated platform for curation and annotation to reduce tooling overhead Org and project-level analytics to track data quality and annotation efficiency How are you approaching training data preparation at [COMPANY]? I'm flexible Tuesdays to Thursdays if you're open to bouncing some ideas.
